_about: Per-camera no-fish-zones. The detector reliably emits false-positive boxes on stationary reef geometry — notably the dark oval holes in the SEAHIVE artificial reef. A detection is dropped only when its bbox closely MATCHES the polygon — i.e., IoU(bbox, polygon-bounding-rect) >= min_iou (default 0.5). This drops the hole's own large false-positive without dropping a fish that swims through, since the fish's bbox is much smaller than the hole and so has tiny IoU even when fully overlapping.

_format.polygon: list of [x, y] integer image-pixel coordinates. Vertices joined in order; the last vertex connects back to the first.
_format.min_iou: optional per-region threshold (default 0.5). Raise toward 1.0 if you're worried about false positives on large fish near the hole; lower toward 0.3 if the detector's box on the hole is consistently off-center.
_format.frame_w / frame_h: image resolution the polygon was annotated against. If the camera resolution changes, the filter rescales polygons proportionally at load time.

_admin_ui: Draw + save regions interactively at /admin/regions.html on the dashboard.
